contenders.handicapper_notes: Holds a massive racing experience edge over an unraced field following an outstanding debut 2nd (beaten a nose) in the Listed Debutante Stakes (88 speed rating) at Caulfield. Proven tactical stalker (P) who carries the standard 58.0kg colts weight comfortably and handles cut in the ground. Clear top pick.

Well-educated Farnan filly from the Anthony and Sam Freedman yard who has shown natural early gate speed (E) winning back-to-back Mornington jump-outs. Receives the 2kg fillies weight allowance (56.0kg) and gets the services of Ben Melham. Threat if she finds a clean rhythm down the center of the track.

Expensive Anamoe colt prepared by Ciaron Maher. Showed sharp progression between jump-outs, closing strongly under a hold at Cranbourne on October 12. Gets a prime outer draw (barrier 8) adjoining Royal Press, allowing Mark Zahra to track into the race nicely in style P.
